home.tagline: Compare contracts clause by clause with AI.
home.description: Add two or more contracts. AI Contrast matches their clauses, shows what is the same and what is different, and rates each difference from the client's point of view.

ratings.title: How differences are rated

green.label: Favorable
green.description: The terms work in the client's favor.

yellow.label: Pay attention
yellow.description: The terms need a careful look.

red.label: Unfavorable
red.description: The terms are unfavorable or risky for the client.

ratings.evidence: Every rating comes with an explanation and a quote from the contract.

home.byok: Start free with the built-in AI model, or connect your own AI provider key. Contract text goes only to the AI provider that processes it.
home.status: Early version: you can add contracts and check the files now. Comparison is coming soon.

upload.title: Contracts to compare
upload.intro: Add each contract with its annexes. Labels A, B, C… follow the order of the contracts.
upload.dropHint: Or drop files here. PDF, DOCX or TXT, up to 10 MB per file, up to 5 files per contract.

errors.length_required: The server could not read the file size. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. Make it smaller or split it into parts.
errors.request_too_large: The request is too large for the server. Remove the file and add a smaller one.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The server did not accept the upload. Reload the page and add the file again.
errors.empty_file: The file is empty. Choose a file with the contract text.
errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX or TXT.
errors.legacy_office_unsupported: This is an old Word (.doc) file or a password-protected file. Remove the password if there is one. Save the file as .docx or PDF and try again.
errors.pages_unsupported: Apple Pages files are not supported. Export to PDF: File → Export To → PDF.
errors.archive_rejected: The file is damaged or has an unsafe structure. Open it in your editor, save it again and add it again.
errors.length_mismatch: The file did not arrive completely. Try again.
errors.upload_timeout: The upload took too long. Check your connection and try again.
errors.busy: The server is busy. Remove the file and add it again in a minute.
errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection, then remove the file and add it again.
errors.timeout: The check took too long. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.aborted: The check was stopped. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.unknown_error: The server gave an unexpected answer. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.too_many_files: A contract can have at most 5 files. Remove a file first.
errors.total_too_large: All files together can be at most 50 MB. Remove some files first.

readiness.contract_without_file: Add at least one file to each contract

upload.privacy: Our server checks each file and does not keep it: files are not stored. File names stay in your browser and are never sent.

announce.contractRemoved: Contract {{label}} removed. The labels of the next contracts moved up.

footer.privacy: We store nothing on our server: no contracts, no keys, no results.
